description: This file contains server-side logic for a warehouse capacity dashboard within an ERP system, including data retrieval, filtering, and permission handling functions.

methods.name: get_data(item_code=None, warehouse=None, parent_warehouse=None, company=None, start=0, sort_by="stock_capacity", sort_order="desc")
methods.description: Returns warehouse capacity data optimized for rendering the dashboard, with sorting and filtering based on user permissions and input parameters.

methods.name: get_filters(item_code=None, warehouse=None, parent_warehouse=None, company=None)
methods.description: Constructs filters for database queries based on provided item, warehouse, company, and parent warehouse identifiers.

methods.name: get_warehouse_filter_based_on_permissions(filters)
methods.description: Checks user permissions related to warehouses and adjusts filters accordingly.

methods.name: get_warehouse_capacity_data(filters, start)
methods.description: Fetches warehouse capacity data from the database and enriches it with current stock balance and occupancy percentage.
